flags: SOC 2 Type II claim unverified: vendor security page (https://www.dzine.ai/security/) returns HTTP 403, preventing direct verification of audit report or certification status. Search results reference the claim, but no independent third-party validation found.
ISO 27001 NOT claimed: vendor mentions ISO/IEC 27035 (incident response) but NOT ISO 27001. Important distinction for regulated use cases.
Free tier content is public by default: images generated on free plans appear in community feed. Significant privacy/IP implication for users; must be clearly communicated at signup.
Data residency not specified: vendor states AWS-hosted environments but does not publicly document specific regions (EU vs US vs multi-region). Enterprise customers should request DPA to confirm.
Limited enterprise documentation: SSO/SAML and advanced controls mentioned but 'may be limited or not clearly documented,' which can block adoption in regulated environments.
No HIPAA or PCI DSS: not suitable for healthcare or payment processing use cases.
Access barriers to trust documentation: security and privacy pages return 403 when accessed directly, reducing transparency and making independent verification difficult.
